query: Identify and report any land cover changes or new building structures between the baseline and follow-up acquisitions.
answerText:
## Change Detection Report (Siamese U-Net Model)

**Trained SiameseUNet model detected change across 20.2% of the image area** (13,240 of 65,536 pixels), indicating moderate scene change (severity: **moderate**).

The remaining 79.8% of pixels were classified as unchanged.

**Model details:** Lightweight Siamese U-Net (~490K parameters) trained on the LEVIR-CD building change detection dataset (1024×1024 RGB image pairs, binary change masks). Inference uses overlapping 256×256 tile sliding with 32px overlap.

**Interpretation:** This result reflects the model's learned change representation. The model was trained on building-related changes in bi-temporal satellite imagery. Results outside that domain may be less reliable.

*Analysis performed by trained SiameseUNet checkpoint: C:\Users\Lenovo\Desktop\SatQuery-AI\backend\checkpoints\best_model.pt (operating threshold: 0.70; confidence: uncalibrated / null)*
